string.text: Enable or disable the UAV's PDA features individually. \n \nEvery feature still works only after the UAV is purchased and refueled before a raid — here you can just hide the ones you don't like. Changes apply immediately, no new game needed.
Features only work after the UAV is purchased and refueled before a raid.
Anomaly-field circles on the map turn cyan when an artifact is inside. \n \nTurn off if you don't want field highlighting.
Highlight known stashes with contents on the PDA map while the UAV is charged. \n \nTurn off if you use the UAV only for artifacts.
PDA message from the UAV when a nearby NPC picks up an artifact: faction, armor and direction (no name). \n \nTurn off if you don't want these alerts.
